result.sql:
WITH step_s1 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $1 AND year = (SELECT max(year) FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $1)),
     step_s2 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $2 AND year = (SELECT max(year) FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $2)),
     step_s3 AS (SELECT a.fips, a.value AS value, b.value AS value_b FROM step_s1 a JOIN step_s2 b USING (fips))
SELECT r.fips, g.name, g.state_fp, r.value,
       r.value_b,
       CASE WHEN g.geom IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geom) END AS geometry
FROM step_s3 r
LEFT JOIN county_geom g USING (fips)
ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

result.sql:
WITH step_s1 AS (SELECT c.fips, COUNT(f.*)::double precision AS value FROM county_geom c LEFT JOIN table_09c8497d75904fc493df702b5862553a_mobilehomeparks f ON ST_Intersects(c.geom, f.geom) GROUP BY c.fips)
SELECT r.fips, g.name, g.state_fp, r.value,
       CASE WHEN g.geom IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geom) END AS geometry
FROM step_s1 r
LEFT JOIN county_geom g USING (fips)
ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000
